mapper.select: SELECT employees.id AS id, employees.name AS name FROM user_departments INNER JOIN employees ON employees.id = user_departments.user_id WHERE user_departments.department_id = #{departmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO departments ( name, province_id, description, department_code, lats, longs, radius, group_id, user_apply, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{department.name}, #{department.provinceId}, #{department.description}, #{department.code}, #{department.lats}, #{department.longs}, #{department.radius}, #{department.settingGroupId}, #{department.userApply}, NOW(), #{department.createdBy}, #{department.isActive} );
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM departments WHERE is_active = 1 AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE departments SET name = #{department.name}, province_id = #{department.provinceId}, description = #{department.description}, lats = #{department.lats}, longs = #{department.longs}, radius = #{department.radius}, group_id = #{department.settingGroupId}, user_apply = #{department.userApply}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{department.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{department.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, name AS name FROM egroups WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN (SELECT group_id FROM departments WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM user_departments WHERE user_id = #{userId}))
